text:
My director looked at the run and says it does not match your generated running poses at all, and it does not look natural. Your "matches" in the last round was wrong, so please be strict this time.




Attached: (1) one board: your 11 generated poses on top, my current 8-drawing loop below; (2) my loop travelling at game speed.




Please look at the pictures, not my numbers, and tell me honestly:

1. The biggest visual differences between your poses and mine, in order of importance (silhouette, leg shapes, knee height, how far the legs spread, torso angle, head, arms, Keyblade, body facing/turn toward the camera, overall energy).

2. Why mine looks unnatural as a run (for example: does it read as walking or lunging, is the weight in the wrong place, do the legs look stiff, are the poses too similar to each other, is the timing wrong).

3. What needs to be done to fix it. Describe each of my 8 drawings as it SHOULD look (a short visual description per drawing, plus the key numbers: hip height change, front knee height, foot positions relative to the hips, torso angle, arm and blade positions). Also say if the camera-facing angle of the body (currently turned 30 degrees from facing the camera toward screen right) or the timing/number of drawings should change.

Text only, no images.
